description: 134 paid APIs as MCP tools, billed per call in USDC on Base. No account, no login.
name: io.github.halowerk/halowerk-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Private key of the paying wallet, hex with or without 0x. Use a throwaway wallet holding only a few dollars of USDC on Base. Without it, only the free catalogue and price tools work.
environmentVariables.name: HALOWERK_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Ceiling per call in USDC. A more expensive service is refused, not bought. Default 0.05.
environmentVariables.name: HALOWERK_MAX_PREIS_USDC

environmentVariables.description: Ceiling per session in USDC. Once reached the server refuses further paid calls. Default 1.00.
environmentVariables.name: HALOWERK_BUDGET_USDC

environmentVariables.description: hero (12 curated services, default), gateway (3 meta-tools, smallest context) or all (70 services).
environmentVariables.name: HALOWERK_MODUS

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for a dry run: returns price and call plan, pays nothing.
environmentVariables.name: HALOWERK_TROCKEN
